column2: 한서윤, Korean woman doctor in her late 20s, calm kind eyes, dark hair in a low ponytail, round glasses, white doctor coat over a dusty turtleneck, stethoscope, medical satchel, bunker survivor

진아라, Korean woman biologist in her late 20s, messy brown hair clipped up, lab coat with a geiger counter, specimen jars, smart and curious

오다인, Korean woman cook in her 20s, warm brown hair in a side braid, bandana, apron over a farm shirt, frying pan and basket of vegetables, friendly smile

한예린, Korean woman nurse in her 20s, soft light-brown hair, nurse cap, clean white-and-blue nurse uniform with a cardigan, first-aid bag, gentle smile
